evals_reused_note: Origin ships 6 real evals but in a bare-list JSON shape ({name, prompt, expected_behavior}), not this project's {skill_name, evals:[{id, prompt, expected_output, expectations}]} schema — reshaped, not rewritten; content and scenarios kept intact. All 6 originals already operate against a local disposable repo path (/tmp/test-repo) rather than a live GitHub remote, so no live-dependency rewrite was needed despite the skill's name. Extended to 8 with 2 additional cases.
live_dependency_note: Origin's own eval design already uses a local disposable repo fixture rather than a real GitHub remote for the destructive-operation cases; the one 'gh repo view'-flavored case (public-repo-push-warning) states the repo's visibility/fork count as given information in the prompt rather than requiring a live API call during grading.
